integrity_notes: The edge threshold and exceptional point are established in prior literature and are not claimed as new.
The new claim is the all-even-size, all-position characteristic-polynomial factorization and resulting threshold classification.
scientific_limitations: Requires even finite \(N\ge4\), open boundaries, \(\mu=0\), \(\delta=J>0\), and one balanced mirror pair of gain/loss potentials.
The zero threshold for interior sites is an infimum statement; no result is claimed away from the flat-band point.
An equivalent formula in inaccessible or unindexed literature cannot be ruled out by search alone.
title: Exact all-size spectral factorization at the flat-band point of a PT-symmetric Kitaev chain
